The problems here are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. About Enode
The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.
Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.
We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.
The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to make Enode’s EV platform more reliable, observable, and efficient.
As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Platform Connect team at Enode, you'll focus on improving the reliability, observability, and scalability of Enode's connectivity layer. This is the part of our API that aggregates integrations with EV chargers, vehicles, and OEM platforms into one cohesive and reliable product for our customers.
This is not an infrastructure or DevOps role. The Platform Connect team owns the product level platform that powers connectivity at Enode, maintaining and extending the layer that links our users to energy devices through consistent, high quality integrations.
You'll take on complex, critical for the business work and see it through, helping keep our platform robust as we scale to more OEMs and partners. Alongside the other senior engineers on the team, you'll help set the technical bar and support the people around you. Expect to move between hands on building, shaping technical direction, and helping teammates, depending on what the team needs most.
Our tech stack centers around a TypeScript based codebase combined with React, Node, AWS, Docker, and PostgreSQL, structured via CDK/CloudFormation.

Build and maintain API integrations with OEMs and energy partners, ensuring they are reliable, performant, and well tested.
Strengthen the connectivity platform by reducing incidents and improving observability, monitoring, and alerting, including the automations and internal tools that make this easier.
Take on complex projects and drive them through to release, breaking them into actionable work and delivering with limited hand-holding.
Help hold a high bar on code quality, testing, and observability, caring about the state of the codebase beyond your own changes.
Work with product and the team to align platform priorities, balancing stability with delivery.
Take ownership beyond your own work and support the engineers around you, sharing knowledge and contributing to technical decisions that keep the team aligned.

s.h: This role will be right for you, if
s.t:
See AI as a strategic lever for engineering work, not just a productivity add on. AI is a real part of how we work as engineers at Enode. We expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. Using it day to day, understanding where it helps and where it falls short, and thinking about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, we're looking for someone eager to get there fast. Additionally:
You have experience writing maintainable, testable backend code, ideally in an environment with a lot of API or integration work.
You're excited about platform engineering in the product sense. Building the connectivity layer that powers integrations, not managing infrastructure or CI/CD pipelines.
You enjoy building new integrations and making existing systems more reliable and observable, and you're systematic about debugging issues across services and preventing them from recurring.
You communicate clearly, contribute to technical discussions, and can explain complex topics to non technical stakeholders.
You take ownership beyond your own work and care about the team. You share knowledge, support teammates, and help improve how the team operates.

Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.
A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.
Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.
Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

At DRW we strive for an environment where technologists are free to pursue solutions to the problems of the business free from arbitrary management constraints and supported by excellent technical resources.

· Collaborating with other software teams, trading desks, and business units

zlyde ist die Software-Entwicklungs-Firma hinter der Anti-Piracy-Technologie von Athletia Sports. Wir entwickeln und betreiben eigene DRM-Lösungen, die Online-Piraterie von Sportinhalten automatisiert aufspüren und eliminieren – von Social-Media-Plattformen über illegale Live Streams bis hin zu IPTV. Damit schützen wir die Rechte namhafter internationaler Sportverbände, Ligen, Clubs und Broadcaster.
Es erwarten Dich spannende technische Herausforderungen in einem kleinen, agilen Team. Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Anti-Piracy-Plattformen suchen wir Dich – als Senior Full-Stack Developer mit starkem Fokus auf moderne Web-Entwicklung.

Ob Du tief im Frontend verwurzelt bist oder Dich im gesamten Stack zu Hause fühlst: Entscheidend ist für uns weniger das exakte Stellenprofil als der Mensch dahinter – jemand, der eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Lust auf ein kleines, agiles Team hat und gut zu uns passt.
Aufgaben
Was Du machen wirst
Weiterentwicklung & Pflege: Ausbau unserer Anti-Piracy-Plattformen mit React, TypeScript und Next.js.
User Interfaces: Konzeption und Umsetzung performanter, hochgradig nutzerfreundlicher Interfaces zur Erfassung, Auswertung und Meldung von Urheberrechtsverletzungen.

Architektur & Qualität: Aktive Mitgestaltung unserer Software-Architektur, Code-Qualität und technischer Richtungsentscheidungen im gesamten Stack.
Teamarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit im kleinen, agilen Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Austausch.
Full-Stack-Integration: Bei Bedarf Anbindung von Backends, APIs sowie Arbeit an der Datenhaltung (u.a. MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery).
Unser Entwickler-Workflow
Eigenes Produkt & Direkter Austausch: Wir entwickeln ein internes Tool für unsere eigenen User und Product Manager. Entwickler und Business Owner arbeiten Hand in Hand und treffen sich regelmäßig.
Modernes Projektmanagement: Anforderungen werden klar strukturiert in Linear erfasst und gepflegt.
Agil & Iterativ: Wir arbeiten in einem flexiblen, iterativen Workflow (Agile Arbeitsweise ohne starre Sprints, dafür mit Daily Standup für optimalen Informationsfluss).
Hohe Code-Qualität: Jedes Code-Review wird im 4-Augen-Prinzip (durch zwei Personen) durchgeführt.
Continuous Deployment: Neue Features und Optimierungen werden kontinuierlich deployed.
Nutzer-Feedback-Loop: Direkte Einbindung der Anwender sorgt für schnelle Feedback-Zyklen und kontinuierliche Produktverbesserung.
Qualifikation

Am wichtigsten sind uns Deine Erfahrung mit unserem Kern-Stack und Deine Arbeitsweise:
Sprachen: Mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung in der Software-Entwicklung mit TypeScript / JavaScript auf Senior-Level.
Frontend & UI: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in React und fundierte Erfahrung mit TailwindCSS (idealerweise auch ShadCN). Next.js-Kenntnisse sind kein Must-have – wir nutzen Next.js Server Actions und GraphQL, was Du problemlos bei uns lernen kannst!
Backend & Datenbanken: Erfahrung in der Anbindung und Entwicklung von Backends und APIs (Express, REST, GraphQL) sowie im Umgang mit Datenbanken (u. a. MongoDB).
Arbeitsweise: Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit dem Drive, Dinge voranzutreiben.
Teamgeist & Leidenschaft: Lust, in einem kleinen, agilen Team Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sowie eine gewisse Begeisterung für das globale Sportgeschehen und Social-Media-Affinität.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und/oder Englischkenntnisse.
Unser Tech-Stack
Frontend: Next.js (Server Actions), GraphQL, ShadCN, TailwindCSS
Backend: Express, GraphQL, REST, Node.js (TSX), Bun
Database: MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery
CI / CD & Source Control: GitHub Actions, Git & GitHub
Hosting: AWS Beanstalk, AWS ECS, AWS Lambda, AWS S3, MongoDB Atlas, Vercel
BI & Analytics: Google BigQuery, Google Data Studio (Looker Studio)
Testing: Automated Regression Testing mit Unit-, Integrations- & E2E-Tests
Project Management: Linear
Logging & APM: Datadog APM, Datadog Logging
AI Tooling: Modernste Coding-Unterstützung durch KI-Agents – OpenCode (Gemini, GPT-Codex 5.3)

Was Dich erwartet
Sinnstiftendes Produkt: Die Arbeit an einer Plattform, die die Urheberrechte großer internationaler Sport-Partner (Verbände, Ligen, Clubs und Broadcaster) schützt.
Spannende Tech-Challenges: Herausfordernde Aufgaben rund um Skalierung, Performance und die Verarbeitung massiver Datenmengen.
Flache Hierarchien: Ein agiles, kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
Echte Flexibilität (Remote-friendly): Arbeite dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist! Wir ermöglichen 100% Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland (mit regelmäßigen, z. B. monatlichen/quartalsweisen Teamevents und Onsite-Treffen in Köln) oder hybrides Arbeiten in unserem modernen Kölner Büro.
Sicherheit: Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle (40 Std./Woche) mit Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.
Interesse?
Klingt ganz nach Dir? Dann schreib uns einfach, warum dieser Job zu Dir passt – inklusive Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

Es soll auf menschlicher Ebene «matchen» und dir Freude bereiten, deine Arbeitstage in unserem Kosmos zu verbringen. Ein eingespieltes Entwicklerteam sowie vielseitige Kundenprojekte und moderne Webtechnologien warten auf dich. Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen einbringen, Neues lernen und Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen.
**Du passt zu uns, weil du -**
· Freude daran hast, Websites, Webshops, digitale Plattformen und webbasierte Anwendungen mitzuentwickeln sowie bestehende Kundenlösungen zu betreuen und weiterzuentwickeln.
· gute Grundlagen in HTML und CSS sowie erste praktische Kenntnisse in JavaScript oder TypeScript mitbringst.
· bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Git, responsiver Webentwicklung, APIs, Datenstrukturen und relationalen Datenbanken gesammelt hast, beispielsweise während deiner Ausbildung, in einem Praktikum, bei eigenen Projekten oder in einer bisherigen Anstellung.
· Interesse an modernen Webarchitekturen und Technologien wie TypeScript, Astro, React und Sanity hast. Zudem bist du bereit, dich in bestehende WordPress- und PHP-Lösungen einzuarbeiten und diese zuverlässig weiterzuentwickeln.
· sorgfältig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert arbeitest, gerne Neues lernst und technische Zusammenhänge gegenüber Kunden und internen Ansprechpersonen verständlich erklären kannst.
· den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit im Team schätzt, Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben übernimmst und frühzeitig auf technische Schwierigkeiten hinweist.
· eine Ausbildung als Informatiker:in EFZ mit Fachrichtung Applikationsentwicklung oder als Mediamatiker:in mit ausgewiesenem Entwicklungsschwerpunkt abgeschlossen hast. Alternativ verfügst du über eine vergleichbare Aus- oder Weiterbildung an einer HF oder FH. Auch als Lehrabgänger:in oder mit erster Berufserfahrung bist du bei uns herzlich willkommen.
· uns idealerweise anhand eines Portfolios, eines GitHub-Profils oder konkreter Projektbeispiele einen Einblick in deine bisherigen Arbeiten geben kannst.
**Was du davon hast?**
* Ein grossartiges, junges Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt und unterstützt.
* Vielseitige Projekte - von bestehenden WordPress-Lösungen bis zu modernen Webarchitekturen mit TypeScript, Astro, React und Sanity.
* Eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, fachliche Begleitung und die Möglichkeit, schrittweise mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
* Moderne Arbeitsplätze in neuen Räumlichkeiten in Wädenswil.
* Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten - inklusive Homeoffice, damit deine Work-Life-Balance stimmt.
* Erfolg ist immer eine Teamleistung. Deshalb klingelt es in deinem Kässeli, wenn wir starke Ergebnisse erzielen. Yay!
* Talente zu fördern liegt uns im Blut. Deshalb unterstützen wir dich gerne bei deinen Aus- oder Weiterbildungsplänen.
* 5 Wochen Ferien und ein zusätzlicher Ferientag an deinem Geburtstag - weil du es verdient hast, zu feiern!
* Weihnachten und Silvester ist Familienzeit - deshalb schenken wir dir je einen weiteren ½ Tag Ferien auf deinem Ferienkonto.
* Wahnsinnig guter «Gavetti»-Kaffee und Stutz-Snackomat.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant-ici.
La-Direction de la Transformation Numérique et de l-Intelligence Augmentée (DTN-IA)-créée, intègre et gère toutes les applications informatiques-d'un-des-systèmes d'information hospitalier les plus performants afin de soutenir les activités cliniques et logistiques des Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève.

Avec un parc de plus de 12'500 postes, 1'300 serveurs pour plus de 250 applications au service de l'ensemble du personnel, disponible 24h/24h et 7j/7j, la DTN-IA gère un système d'information RH pour les 13'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs des HUG et des 7 autres institutions genevoises et un ERP performant pour les processus logistiques et financiers des plus complexes.-
La DTN-IA-crée-un dossier patient informatisé à la pointe du secteur et participe au rayonnement des HUG grâce à une richesse fonctionnelle reconnue et des collaborations étroites avec tous les professionnels et professionnelles de santé et leurs directions transverses. Par ailleurs, la DTN-IA intègre des équipements biomédicaux de pointe et du quotidien ainsi que des applications spécialisées pour tous les plateaux médico-techniques.-
Le métier de la DTN-IA est de soutenir les activités quotidiennes et de bâtir le futur d'un hôpital moderne et performant, selon les axes stratégiques de l'institution en s'appuyant sur les meilleures pratiques et les standards les plus exigeants.-
## Description du poste ##
Intégrez et renforcez une équipe composée de 2 développeurs fullstack et un lead développeur, dont la mission est de poursuivre le développement et l-évolution de l-application Greco, le logiciel de gestion de planning et de téléconsultation utilisé par le personnel.

Le logiciel est également utilisé par les patients et patientes grâce à l-application Concerto. L-équipe travaille de manière agile en s-inspirant fortement de la méthodologie Scrum tout en s-adaptant aux contraintes liées au milieu hospitalier qui impliquent d-être capable de parfois devoir changer rapidement de tâche pour s-adapter aux priorités.
Vous participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges techniques, en traduisant les besoins fonctionnels en spécifications détaillées. À partir des spécifications techniques, vous développez le logiciel, aussi bien sur la partie front-end que back-end, en utilisant les technologies de pointe et une architecture microservices.

Vous faites évoluer la solution et garantissez sa maintenance, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux. Concrètement, vous développez en autonomie les fonctionnalités et corrections qui vous sont attribuées.
Grâce à votre esprit d-équipe, vous collaborez étroitement avec l-équipe pour développer des solutions et des fonctionnalités fiables et évolutives. Vous partagez les meilleures pratiques et adoptez une approche critique et constructive dans une optique d-amélioration continue en faisant preuve d-une forte orientation solution.
Tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, grâce à votre sens de la communication, vous contribuez au développement du logiciel de manière optimale et structurée, assurant un lien essentiel avec les coordinateurs et coordinatrices greco des différents départements médicaux.

Vous adaptez votre langage en fonction de vos interlocuteurs et interlocutrices pour vulgariser les termes techniques, challengez les solutions proposées, et collaborez activement avec les parties prenantes pour trouver les adaptations les plus pertinentes.
De plus, vous veillez à la mise à jour et à la rédaction de la documentation nécessaire. Vous mettez à profit votre capacité de synthèse et votre pragmatisme pour mener votre mission dans les délais impartis et garantir un résultat de qualité.
Vous participez activement à l-ensemble des phases d'un projet informatique, de son initialisation à sa finalisation, en vous assurant de produire les livrables attendus à chacune de ces phases. En outre, vous assurez également le support utilisateurs de niveau 3, en relation avec les autres services de la DTN-IA, tout en assurant une orientation client forte.

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en informatique ou d'un diplôme jugé équivalent, et vous justifiez d-une expérience d-au moins cinq ans dans une fonction de développement fullstack en contact avec le métier.
Vous maîtrisez une architecture microservices avec les technologies Java/J2EE avec le Framework Spring, en particulier Spring Boot, Spring Data r2dbc, Spring cloud stream et Spring Security, mais également OAuth2, Hibernate et SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL). Vous avez effectué de nombreux tests unitaires et d'intégration, avec les outils de test Junit5 et Mockito. Une connaissance de l-architecture microservices orienté évènement avec la solution Kafka constitue un atout important.
Pour la partie frontend, vous détenez une expertise sur Angular avec la version 20 idéalement.
Vous savez utiliser les outils de collaboration (GIT, JIRA et Confluence) ainsi que les outils de construction Maven et Docker. Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes agiles, notamment Scrum, constitue un atout.
Vous faites preuve d-une excellente capacité relationnelle dans les environnements pluridisciplinaires, alliant communication, vulgarisation des termes techniques et écoute active pour garantir la compréhension des besoins.
Vous savez prendre du recul et tirer parti des retours d'expérience pour progresser. Votre sens de l-initiative est un atout précieux pour le développement de solutions innovantes.
Vous faites preuve d-organisation, d-un bon sens relationnel et d-autonomie dans la recherche de solutions. Par ailleurs, vous avez démontré votre capacité d-initiative et vous souhaitez relever des défis dans un environnement exigeant et de grande technicité.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes.

The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases.

The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
The Simulation ML Infrastructure team builds scalable AI/ML infrastructure to accelerate the Simulator team in sustainably innovating and building state of the art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo Driver.

To increase the fidelity and steerability of the simulations, we employ large foundation models trained on massive datasets to model the real world, including but not limited to, realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather etc.
We seek an experienced Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to lead the development of advanced AI/ML infrastructure for multi-billion parameter foundation models in ML accelerator-friendly simulations. Your expertise in massive model scaling, ML accelerators, and distributed training will be required for designing and scaling our systems.
This role reports to an Engineering Manager.

Be part of a world-class, high-performing research engineering team to advance the state of the art of ultra realistic multi-agent simulations using foundation models.
Collaborate closely with the core Google DeepMind and Waymo Realism Modeling teams in London, and Waymo Oxford to use the large models to improve sim realism.
Provide deep technical leadership on large-scale ML model architectures, especially for autonomous vehicle models. Work at the intersection of data engineering, model development, and deployment, and provide guidance on architectural decisions and technical directions. Own large, complex systems, driving architectures that meet technical and business objectives.
Design and scale large distributed systems covering the ML lifecycle, supporting planet-scale dataset generation and model training.
Collaborate cross-functionally to derive performance and system-level requirements for large ML systems. Translate product/business goals into measurable technical deliverables, ensuring system component alignment.
Mentor junior engineers, growing their expertise and fostering a collaborative culture.

BS in Computer Science, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in machine learning infrastructure such as developing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale machine learning systems from data to model.

MS in Computer Science, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in machine learning infrastructure such as developing, designing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale machine learning systems from data to model.
Solid experience in the development and optimization of machine learning infrastructure tools like DeepSpeed, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
Strong expertise in distributed training techniques, including gradient sharding and optimization strategies for scaling large models across ML accelerator profiling tools to uncover performance bottlenecks.
Deep understanding of state-of-the-art machine learning models such as auto-regressive transformers and familiarity with custom-kernels for diverse h/w compute based efficiency.
Practical familiarity in Autonomous Driving, Simulations, and ML accelerators is a huge plus.

Drive the migration of existing polyglot solutions to standardized Rust and TypeScript, towards more standardized and portable deployment architectures, and pass on technical learning to the broader organisation to embed the technical strategies throughout.

7+ years experience as a Software Developer or Engineer, including experience working with enterprise-level complexity.
High proficiency in at least one enterprise-quality programming language and its ecosystem. For example, C# .NET or Java and Spring.
Must have some experience with a lower-level language for application or systems development such as Rust (preferable) or C++ .
Experience in TypeScript and React or similar front-end frameworks, and a well-developed understanding of web application development.
Hands-on experience deploying to Azure and/or AWS, including building CI/CD pipelines and using infrastructure scripting frameworks (e.g., Terraform).
Demonstrable experience in software design for distributed and asynchronous architecture. In particular, you will need to show examples of projects using microservices and messaging where you have been a key contributor to the design and construction.
You will already have embraced the use of LLMs over hand-coding and be able to articulate how this has improved the speed to deliver and safety of the systems you build.
With the help of LLMs you can produce clear and concise design documents.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills to translate between requirements and technical tasks.

Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

Be part of an innovative team, with a culture of learning and collaboration.
Contribute to interesting, diverse, and commercially minded work for well-respected clients.
Opportunity for professional growth and development.
Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.

s.h: Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.
s.t:
This role is Auckland based, regular in-office attendance is required. Work within our beautifully designed office and from home (hybrid working model).
Propellerhead is an equal opportunity workplace which is free from discrimination.

*Please note - only applications with a cover letter will be reviewed.
It's very important to us that you include a cover letter with your application - it's your chance to tell us more about who you are and what you value.
At Propellerhead, we use AI thoughtfully as part of our delivery practices - considered integration helps us stay at the forefront of technology and create innovative, valuable solutions for our clients.
In recruitment, however, AI isn’t used to assess skills, experience or suitability for a role. Every application is reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair, engaged and thoughtfully human process.
Therefore we kindly ask that you refrain from using it in your application. We're excited to learn about your unique experiences and ideas, so please apply as your authentic self!

Candidates that progress may be asked to agree to a police background check, credit history check, other assessments and provide evidence of qualifications.

Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB , touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.
We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer (Distributed) who’s excited about solving hard problems in distributed systems and enjoys turning complex challenges into elegant, reliable solutions.

Shape infrastructure using CMake or Bazel.
Configure and monitor with YAML/JSONnet, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Automate testing and performance validation with load-testing scripts (YandexTank or your own).

Working knowledge of SQL ( MariaDB /MySQL/PostgreSQL).

Comfort with Linux/Unix systems. (systemd, cgroups, logging, etc), and debugging tools.
Understanding of performance profiling approaches.

Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with . Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.
Why This Role Exists
We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.
The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
Your Toolbox
We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.
What We Expect at This Level
6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.

s.h: Not Suitable for the Role If…
s.t:
You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems.

This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.
We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.
Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.
Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.
Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.
Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.
Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.
Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.
Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.
Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).
DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).
High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.
Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).
Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.
Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.
Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).
Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.
Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.
Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.
Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.
Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .
Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN ’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.
We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.
The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.
Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change.

That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.

Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included. Responsibilities
Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

6 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including several years operating in production what you built.
A record of owning system level design rather than components alone. You have been the person accountable for how a whole system fits together.
Deep experience with distributed systems, including failure modes you have personally debugged rather than only read about.
Demonstrated coaching. Be ready to name engineers who grew because of how you worked with them, and to say what actually changed.
Experience owning APIs that other teams depend on, including versioning and breaking change migrations.
Excellent communication, particularly in writing. You can write a design document another team can act on without a meeting.
Depth in at least one domain relevant to this team: data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.
Experience leading delivery across more than one team, without formal authority over the people involved.
Strong fundamentals, and the judgement to recognize when the simple answer is the right one.

Experience as a formal tech lead, or in a staff level role.

Experience with high volume data pipelines, streaming systems, or telemetry and time series data.
Experience putting machine learning or LLM systems into production.
Experience working close to physical infrastructure, where the software must account for hardware that fails.
